points.name: 既然...就..., 因此/于是, 无论...都...
points.explain: 既然 A 就 B means "since A is the case, then B". 因此 and 于是 both mean "therefore/so", introducing a result. 无论 A 都 B means "no matter A, still B" — it pairs naturally with 都 for "regardless".

sentences.en: Since you want to go, let's go.

sentences.zh: 天气不好因此我们不去
sentences.en: The weather isn't good, therefore we won't go.
She was hungry, so she ate.
Regardless of whether you go or not, I'll go.
Even if [he's] very busy, he still goes.

sentences.zh: 虽然很忙然而他很高兴
sentences.en: Although [he's] very busy, however he is happy.
